# IT Security and Operations Monitoring Plan

This plan details key monitoring and review activities for IT security and operations.

## Monitoring Activities

*   Monitor encryption standards quarterly.
*   Monitor encryption standards based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor firewall settings quarterly.

## Review and Optimization

*   Review the database migration for strategy 2026.
*   Optimize the database migration for strategy 2026.
